description: t.w waits in its receiver's poll_closed (channel/oneshot.rs:1373). t.d sends at 100: a value is not a close, and Rust's send wakes the recv waker only, leaving the closed waker registered (:731-760), so t.w is never polled again and stays parked to the end; t.x sleeping until 300 shows the run went on. Both labs then step with nothing to run until their stuck bound (1000 steps), within max_steps.
